headline: Performance Marketing | Full-Funnel Testing | Paid Media Analytics

summary: Performance marketer experienced in combining campaign execution, creative collaboration and full-funnel analysis. Scaled monthly marketing volume fourfold while improving ROAS from 1.5 to 3.5, and managed acquisition across Google, Microsoft, Meta, Instagram and TikTok. Agency portfolio experience adds practical client strategy, account discipline and actionable recommendations across multiple campaigns and business priorities.
